scope: NGC Expanded U-Net seed 17; existing shared-state draws; video-first prototype, no new inference or website change

geometry.selection: support-rich region nearest supported-mask centroid, independent of density
geometry.projection: orthographic; physical scale bar and orientation triad

rendering.colour: fixed logarithmic density scale, clipped at 0.5 and 8 times mean
rendering.mask: support >= 0.5 and positive coverage; all eight interpolation corners required
rendering.uncertainty: Four draws illustrate variation, not convergence or calibrated real-DESI uncertainty

tidal_environments: deferred; not computed or reused from older fields
graph_refresh: Attempted local AST update on compute; existing fcntl.flock OSError 524 prevents refresh. No bypass or global-index update.
drafts: Other subdirectories in the same bounded output root are development renders; only release is the validated deliverable.
